thread.title: New Mexico State men's golf ties for fifth at Border Olympics

author: f. b. duggan
title: New Mexico State men's golf ties for fifth at Border Olympics
text:
The New Mexico State men’s golf team secured a tie for fifth place at the Border Olympics, which concluded on Tuesday at Laredo Country Club. The Aggies finished with a combined score of 9-over in a competitive field that included several strong Texas teams and a ranked Houston squad.
Sophomore Mateo Payán led the Aggies, finishing even par over 54 holes to earn his sixth career top-25 finish and his second top-15 placement of the season. Payán also tied for first in par-3 scoring among all 76 competitors, playing those holes at 2-under.
Jackson Funkhouser made his debut tournament appearance for New Mexico State and finished tied for 18th after shooting an even-par 71 in the final round, marking his first career top-20 finish. Javier Delgadillo also tied for 18th, matching his best performance since the start of the season.
Max Chan was next for the Aggies, finishing in 34th place with a score of 6-over. Kostak Horno competed as an individual and placed 46th, while defending Border Olympics champion Ethan Klose rounded out the team in 50th position.
As a group, New Mexico State ranked third among all teams in par-3 scoring average (3.12) and tied for third in par-5 scoring (4.76).
For more information about NM State Men’s Golf, updates are available on Twitter (@NMStateMGolf), Instagram (@NMStateMGolf), Facebook (NM State Men’s Golf), and NMStateSports.com.
